scope: Small prediction-blind assistant-reviewed partial ROI validation; not a representative benchmark or expert-certified ground truth.

selection.group_uniqueness: All selected loss-case groups distinct; derived earlier pair shares its reviewed parent validation group.
selection.eligibility: Frozen automatic pass, zero core and target QA flags, anchor area>=1600 square metres and bounding width/height>=40 metres as search aids only, at least one later local observation. Exact interior>=4 is a subsequent preparation gate.
selection.ranking: Within stratum, ascending group_id/event_id, existing frozen review-queue top-candidate rank, then pair_id; select all primaries before disjoint-group alternates. Missing alternates remain missing.
selection.footprints: Complete 64x64 feature footprint must avoid every frozen train/test conservative group footprint and all13 actual training grids. No split reassignment.
selection.selection_bias: Clear-image and geometry-filtered convenience sample; not random population validation. No NDVI contrast or model prediction selection.

review.timeline: Every local same-year observation within45 days eachside; no omitted cloudy/uncertain observations.
review.acceptance: Reviewed forest before and clearing after primary pair, later clear persistence, at least3 reviewed stable control dates including both endpoints, numeric QA zero for each clear ROI claim.
review.stable_pair_rule: Earliest chronological5-30day pair with reviewed target forest and control stable, bothdates<=loss pre-date. Derived pair identity/lineage explicit; supervise control ROI ONLY, all other pixels255. No eligible pair is retained as unavailable.
review.rejections: Retain every prepared disposition. Use predeclared same-stratum alternate only after primary rejection; do not search until success.

evaluation.label_lock: Commit finalized hash-bound reviews and exported validation manifest BEFORE any validation model inference.
evaluation.metrics: Reviewed pixels only; report clearing pairs and stable-only pairs separately and pooled; six temporal samples represent at most3 geographic groups. Undefined metrics remain undefined.

limitations: Assistant image review is not independent expert annotation.
Ignored pixels never become negatives; partial ROIs do not establish complete clearing boundaries or area.
Validation is for development; test groups remain untouched.
Observed image-date intervals are not exact felling dates.
